chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn said to Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليه السلام:
May I recite in the bathhouse and conduct a marriage contract there?

key_terms.أَقْرَأُ: I recite; here, asking about recitation in a bathhouse
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: peace be upon him; honorific for the Imam
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; an expression of permissibility
key_terms.وَأَنْكِحُ: and I marry; here, meaning to conduct a marriage contract

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to recite or perform a marriage contract in a bathhouse according to Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal question posed to Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليه السلام about reciting and conducting a marriage contract in a bathhouse. The Imam’s reply indicates permissibility, showing that neither act is inherently prohibited in that setting.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.234 - Ali ibn Yaqtin said to Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as):
'May I recite (in the bathhouse) and marry (perform a marriage contract) there?'
Imam (as) said: 'There is no harm.'
